Name: En-rogel
ModernLocation: Unknown; near Jerusalem, in the Kidron valley
Description: A spring near Jerusalem, on the Judah-Benjamin border, where Jonathan and Ahimaaz waited during Absalom's revolt, and where Adonijah later held his feast.
BiblicalSignificance: En-rogel is the spring of David's messengers in Absalom's revolt and of Adonijah's rival feast.
